newsitem.title: GREECE: HELLENIC CENTRE FOR INVESTMENTS INAUGURATED MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: HELLENIC CENTRE FOR INVESTMENTS INAUGURATED MONDAY.

text.p: The Hellenic Centre for Investments (ELKE) was inaugurated today by National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou.
Papandoniou said the one-stop investment shop would play a pivotal role in promoting large-scale direct investments in Greece by cutting through red tape.

ELKE is offering information, advice and evaluation of investment proposals submitted by private companies. Each proposal should exceed 3.0 billion drachmas or 1.0 billion if 50 percent is funded by foreign capital.
Nickos Skoulas is the president of ELKE which is mainly financed by the European Union. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
